{{Quote|Fortunately, we have a fully qualified medic back at HQ.|An Imperial Major to a disfigured Luke Skywalker, on Myrkr|<ref name="Heir to the Empire 6">[[Heir to the Empire 6|''Heir to the Empire'' 6]]</ref>}}
'''Imperial medics''' were combat [[Medic/Legends|medics]] [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|personnel]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] who were responsible for providing first aid and had specialized medical training in trauma care on the battlefield for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] had their own specialized personnel known as [[stormsurgeon]]s or [[stormmedic]]s.

==Overview==
While most Imperial soldiers had basic battlefield first-aid training,<ref name="Empire 18">[[Empire 18|''Empire'' 18]]</ref> Imperial medics were specially trained and equipped to treat the wounds of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and other units in the midst of battle. To accomplish their role, they carried [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] and other medical supplies.<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=PSP, PS2 and Wii}}</ref><ref name="Darklighter">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Darklighter]]''</ref> If challenged in the field, they often made use of their [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]],<ref name="TFU" /><ref name="Empire 18" /> which they used with surprising accuracy.<ref name="TFU" />

They wore varying uniforms depending on which branch of the military they belonged to, and the environment in which they were deployed. On terrestrial worlds when not belonging to the Stormtrooper Corps, they wore the distinctive uniform of an [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army trooper]] (albeit colored light blue),<ref name="TFU" /><ref name="Empire 18" /> and on naval ships they were dressed in a [[Imperial Navy crewman]]'s jumpsuit with backpacks and a hip-pack for carrying medical supplies.<ref name="Darklighter" /> The Stormtrooper Corps, likewise, wore similar armor to the Stormtroopers,<ref name="DF:SFTE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> although they were distinguished by their possessing bronze pauldrons on the right shoulder.<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:MutinyA.jpg|Imperial medics treat stormtroopers injured during the [[Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic/Legends|Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic]].|thumb|250px]]
Medics were part of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] since its inception. They were deployed on contested worlds such as [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="TFU" /> [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]],<ref name="TFU" /> [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]],<ref name="Empire 18" /> [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]]<ref name="Heir to the Empire 6" /> and [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="The Last Command 5">[[The Last Command 5|''The Last Command'' 5]]</ref> They also served on naval vessels such as the [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']]<ref name="Empire 9">[[Empire 9|''Empire'' 9]]</ref> and even on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="TFU" />
